correctness.rationale: The detailed-balance beta-binomial law is explicit and its moments follow from factorial moments. A direct generator identity gives the unique centered Poisson solution for the quadratic escape rate, and differentiated tilted Perron eigenvalue gives the claimed cumulant rate including its martingale clock term. Algebra yields the exact expression, and independent 54-case exact rational full-generator tests match every claim at the tested points. Endpoints N=1 and positive d, as well as all crossover regimes, are covered analytically.

value.rationale: Total jump activity is a natural measurable time-integrated kinetic statistic for an attractive conservative particle process. Exact first and second cumulant rates separate stationary occupation fluctuations from transition-count noise. A sharp particle-number dependent \(N^{2/3}\) crossover in the Fano factor, and its 1+1/(8c^3) scaling curve, give a structural benchmark not supplied by ordinary static beta-binomial data. Poissonian ratio is explicitly distinguished from Poisson distribution.
